--- your triage ---
onset: 2026-03-17T09:19:00.000Z
The incident began at 09:19:00Z when supplier_p95_ms jumped from 208ms to 7791ms (metrics/downstream.csv:20-21), a 37x increase. This coincides with http error_rate jumping from 0.0014 to 0.0451 (metrics/http.csv:20-21) and http p95_ms beginning its climb from 173.16ms to 182.54ms (metrics/http.csv:20-21). The downstream supplier latency degradation is the root cause, as it precedes and explains the API latency and error rate increases. Notably, rps stayed relatively flat (331-366 range, only 10.6% swing), indicating this was not a traffic spike but a downstream dependency failure. The deploy at 09:03:00Z (changes.jsonl:1) occurred 16 minutes before the incident, making it an unlikely cause. The ApiLatencyP95 alert fired at 09:26:00Z (alerts.jsonl:1), 7 minutes after onset, and InflightRequestsHigh at 09:30:00Z (alerts.jsonl:2) as requests queued up behind slow supplier calls.

Every entry in timeline, evidence and ruled_out needs at least one citation.
In "quote", copy a distinctive fragment of the text that appears on that exact
line, verbatim. A citation whose quote is not on the line it names is rejected.
